why.value: Paid Vinexposium request: let organisers mark custom category filters as required, so users and exhibitors must pick at least one.
why.source: EP-56915 comment 2026-09-11 by Ajay Singh; Confluence https://expoplatform.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/P2/pages/2112389133/Required+Custom+Category+Filters

rationale.value: Organisers want to mark custom category filters as required, so users and exhibitors must choose at least one category from each such filter when setting activity, interest or product categories. It is a paid client request, so the brief is being confirmed with the client before the build starts. The rule also applies to categories saved earlier, and the category limit is raised automatically when there are more required filters than the limit allows, so users cannot reach a dead end.
rationale.source: Confluence https://expoplatform.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/P2/pages/2112389133/Required+Custom+Category+Filters; EP-56915 comment 2026-09-11 by Ajay Singh

impact.value: Organisers get at least one category from every required filter on user and exhibitor records. It covers seven Add category popups: user and exhibitor profile activity/interest categories, products, brands, exhibitor events, news and groups. The admin Categories page gains an Optional/Required filter type and some layout clean-up. The backend will not enforce the rule, so categories set through the admin panel, import, the API or the mobile app are not checked.
impact.source: Confluence https://expoplatform.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/P2/pages/2112389133/Required+Custom+Category+Filters; EP-56915 comments 2026-09-22 by Konstantin Shein and 2026-09-23 by Vladyslav Dziubenko
